datasets.name: Bailong River Basin landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: We established an open and high-precision remote sensing landslide dataset for the Bailong River Basin, comprising 773 annotated landslide samples and 16 multisource remote sensing images.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2A imagery
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2A, an optical remote sensing satellite operated under European Space Agency’s (ESA) Copernicus program... The optical remote sensing data utilized in this study are cloud-free Sentinel-2A data acquired on April 29, 2021 and provided by ESA.

datasets.name: ALOS DEM
datasets.verbatim: DEM data were obtained from 12.5-m resolution terrain products generated by the Phased-Array L-Band Synthetic Aperture Radar (PAL-SAR) onboard the Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS) of Japan.

methods.name: Dual-stream coding fusion landslide detection network (DSCF-LDNet)
methods.summary: DSCF-LDNet is a dual-stream encoder-decoder network. The encoder uses a spatial branch (MSRNet) for fine-grained spatial features and a sequential branch (MSRNet-LSTM) for cross-channel semantic dependencies. An attention-gated decoder module (AGDM) is used to enhance multiscale feature interactions and landslide sensitivity.
methods.verbatim: To address the challenges of landslide identification in complex geological environments, this study selects Bailong River Basin as the experimental scene, constructs a dedicated landslide dataset, and proposes a novel landslide detection framework, the dual-stream coding fusion landslide detection network (DSCF-LDNet).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom code for the DSCF-LDNet method is not provided.
